summary: The note is a short biographical entry on Ludwig Gaim, nicknamed "Standartenführer", a World War I flying ace. It records his birth date of 1 April 1892, notes that his date of death is unknown, and states he was credited with five aerial victories. It also says he ended the war with the rank of Vizefeldwebel.
one_line: Ludwig Gaim was a World War I flying ace credited with five aerial victories, who ended the war as a Vizefeldwebel.
key_facts: Ludwig Gaim was born on 1 April 1892.
Ludwig Gaim's date of death is unknown.
Ludwig Gaim is also known by the nickname "Standartenführer".
Ludwig Gaim was a World War I flying ace.
Ludwig Gaim was credited with five aerial victories.
Ludwig Gaim ended the First World War with the rank of "Vizefeldwebel".
